title: Optimal feedrate planning on a five-axis parametric tool path with global geometric and kinematic constraints
publisher: Journal of Computational Design and Engineering, 2022, 9(6), 2355–2374
author: Hong-Yu Ma; Chun-Ming Yuan; Li-Yong Shen; Xiao-Shan Gao
locator: Abstract and problem formulation: joint-space/axis velocity, acceleration and jerk constraints are combined with Cartesian-space chord-error constraints; the paper explains the nonlinear mapping between the two spaces.
notes: Supports the conceptual distinction between machine-axis kinematic constraints and Cartesian geometric path constraints in five-axis CNC feedrate planning. The paper's optimisation values are not machine-specific limits for this repository.
